spatial_flow_description: Arrange five main steps in a gently descending left-to-right flow. At far left place “候选轨迹” with “当前策略｜工具版本”. It feeds “证据核验”, a taller box with four internal rows “执行状态”, “验证器”, “轨迹一致性”, “不确定性”. A rightward arrow reaches “正确性判定”, with “独立标签”. Its downward branch terminates at “未知轨迹” with “保留待审”; this branch has no path into training. Its rightward branch reaches “训练效用”, with “配对探测增益”. A small independent box above that stage, “独立开发集”, supplies evaluation evidence via a downward arrow. Below and to the right, branch the utility output into two equally prominent boxes: “监督训练池” with “有界样本权重” and “同任务偏好对” with “独立优劣证据”. Make the distinction between correctness and training utility visible through separate boxes and separate incoming evidence. Do not draw a probability scale or any invented score values.
caption_note: 路线二：分开判断轨迹正确性和增量训练效用。配对短程探测的收益来自独立开发任务；未知轨迹保留待审，不视作成功样本。
No measurements or pre-experiment results are rendered.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: White canvas and WHITE box fills with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
At most three blue chromatic colors plus neutrals.
Native structural rectangles, dividers and connectors only; every main block has a geometric anchor.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Dashed borders for frozen modules; dashed arrows for feedback or unverified mechanism.
No overall title, invented formulas, dimensions or performance numbers.
Readable simplified Chinese, no cropping or overlapping labels.
